desc: Discover the ultimate in comfort and functionality with the Allen Company BakTrak Terrain Rifle Sling, Black. Engineered with advanced BakTrak technology, this rifle sling is designed to meet the needs of hunters and shooters who demand durability and ease of use. The proprietary construction system ensures a perfect balance of strength, lightweight design, and user comfort. This adjustable sling comes with integrated swivels for effortless attachment and detachment. The rubberized traction pad provides a secure grip on your shoulder, allowing you to carry your rifle for extended periods without discomfort. Whether you are out hunting or at the range, the Allen Company BakTrak Terrain Rifle Sling keeps your firearm accessible and ready for action.
